title: UPDATE: AntLingAGI Opens Weights for 124B Parameter Ling-3.1-Flash Model
summary:
AntLingAGI has released the open weights for its Ling-3.1-flash-1019 large language model. The text-only model uses a Mixture-of-Experts architecture with 124B total parameters and 5.1B active parameters, enabling it to run on a single GPU server and keep sensitive data on-premises.

The release follows the introduction of the model's benchmarks, including an Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index score of 44, up from 41 for the previous Ling-3.1-flash version. The model also demonstrated gains in agentic tasks, posting an AutomationBench-AA score of 68% and an AA-Briefcase score of 1524 Elo.

Looks like @AntLingAGI, a maybe-not-so-well-known upcoming Chinese AI lab, is soon going to drop a DeepSeek-v4.1 Flash-1710 and GLM-5.3-level model!

Better yet, it's a lot smaller than those two. It's a 560B-parameter MoE with 25B active parameters. It seems to be text-only, though.
